projects.name: Customer Analytics Dashboard
projects.description:
Build an analytics dashboard that unifies three data domains into a single visualization layer: (1) customer CSV data processing/ingestion, (2) application log analysis, and (3) dashboard visualization components. Scope covers ingestion pipelines, normalization and validation, log parsing and aggregation, metric definitions, API/query layer, UI components, testing, and deployment. Goal: deliver a maintainable dashboard with reliable data pipelines and clear, drill-down visualizations.

Tags: analytics, dashboard, data-pipeline, csv, log-analysis, visualization

tasks.name: M1 — Foundation & Architecture
tasks.details: Establish the technical foundation for the analytics dashboard: repository structure, runtime environment, storage choice, data contracts between the three pipelines (customer CSV, application logs, visualization layer), and cross-cutting concerns such as configuration, secrets, logging, and error handling conventions. Exit criteria: developers can run the stack locally and the data contracts are agreed and documented.

tasks.name: M2 — Customer CSV Ingestion & Processing
tasks.details: Build the end-to-end pipeline for customer CSV files: upload/landing, schema detection, parsing, validation and error quarantine, normalization/cleansing, deduplication, and loading into the analytics store in a query-ready shape. Exit criteria: a representative set of customer CSVs loads idempotently with row-level validation reporting and a documented quality score.

tasks.name: M3 — Application Log Analysis Pipeline
tasks.details: Build ingestion and analysis for application logs: log shipping/collection, format detection and parsing (structured and semi-structured), normalization of severity levels and timestamps, error grouping/fingerprinting, aggregation into time-bucketed metrics, and retention/backfill handling. Exit criteria: logs flow into aggregations that support error-rate, latency, and top-error trend visualizations.

tasks.name: M4 — Data Model, Metrics & Query API
tasks.details: Define and expose the analytical layer that sits between raw pipelines and the UI: dimensional model (facts/dimensions), metric catalogue with precise definitions, aggregation/rollup jobs, and a query API (or query service) with filtering, time-range, and pagination support. Exit criteria: every dashboard widget can be served by one documented, tested API endpoint.

tasks.name: M5 — Visualization Components & Dashboard UI
tasks.details: Build the front-end: shared component library (chart wrappers, KPI tiles, data tables, filters), dashboard layout and navigation, widget-level data binding to the query API, loading/empty/error states, responsive behavior, and accessibility. Exit criteria: the dashboard renders all planned widgets against real API data with usable states and no blocking accessibility issues.

tasks.name: M6 — Quality, Deployment & Documentation
tasks.details: Harden and ship: automated test coverage across pipelines and UI, data quality/regression checks, CI/CD pipeline, environment provisioning, observability for the dashboard itself, runbooks, and user documentation. Exit criteria: one-command deploy to staging, passing test suite, documented runbook, and a demoed end-to-end flow.

tasks.name: Repo scaffolding, linting & CI skeleton
tasks.details: Create monorepo/workspace layout (ingestion, log-analysis, api, web), initialize package manifests, add formatter/linter config, pre-commit hooks, and a minimal CI workflow that runs lint + unit test stub. Done when a fresh clone can install deps and run lint/test green.

tasks.name: Local dev environment (compose: DB, queue, app services)
tasks.details: Provide a docker-compose (or equivalent) dev stack with the analytics database, message queue/worker, API, and web app. Include seed scripts and a documented `make dev` / single command startup. Done when a new developer reaches a running stack in under 15 minutes.

tasks.name: Define data contracts between the three domains
tasks.details: Document the canonical record shapes produced by the CSV pipeline, the log pipeline, and consumed by the query API/UI: field names, types, nullability, timezone conventions, entity keys, and versioning. Publish as versioned schema docs plus machine-readable schema stubs (JSON Schema / Avro). Done when all three domains and the API team sign off on v1.

tasks.name: Storage & stack selection (ADR)
tasks.details: Evaluate and record an Architecture Decision Record for the analytics store (e.g. Postgres + columnar extension vs warehouse), file landing zone, and log store approach. Cover cost, query latency at expected volume, operational burden, and local-dev parity. Done when ADR is merged and the choice is reflected in the dev environment.

tasks.name: Configuration, secrets & structured logging conventions
tasks.details: Add typed config loading per environment, secret handling (env/secret manager, never committed), and a shared structured-logging helper with correlation IDs. Include error-handling conventions (error taxonomy, retry/backoff policy). Done when all services emit consistent structured logs with correlation IDs.

tasks.name: CSV landing zone & upload entrypoint
tasks.details: Implement the intake path for customer CSVs: object-store/local landing directory plus an upload endpoint (or scheduled drop-folder watcher). Capture file metadata (name, size, checksum, uploader, received-at) in an ingestion ledger. Done when an uploaded file is recorded exactly once with a checksum.

tasks.name: Robust CSV parser with schema detection
tasks.details: Streaming CSV reader handling delimiter/quote/encoding detection, BOM, embedded newlines, ragged rows, and header normalization. Infer column types and produce a detected-schema report per file. Tune for large files with bounded memory. Done when a 1M-row file parses without loading fully into memory.

tasks.name: CSV validation rules engine
tasks.details: Implement the declarative rule layer only: rule definitions for required fields, type/range checks, and email/phone/date format checks, plus a pure evaluator that returns a list of violations per row. Includes unit tests over fixture rows. Done when rules are config-driven and every violation carries a machine-readable code and message.

tasks.name: Normalization & cleansing transforms
tasks.details: Implement canonical normalization: name casing/whitespace, address parts, country/region codes, currency amounts to minor units, date/time to UTC ISO-8601, phone/email lowercase normalization, and null sentinel handling. Keep transforms pure and unit-testable. Done when a fixture dataset yields a fully canonical output set.

tasks.name: Deduplication & idempotent load (upsert strategy)
tasks.details: Define natural/business keys for customer records, implement exact + fuzzy duplicate detection, and load with deterministic upsert (merge on key, keep latest by source precedence and updated-at). Re-running the same file must produce zero net changes. Done when a replayed file is a no-op and duplicates are reported.

tasks.name: Ingestion run report & data quality score
tasks.details: Persist per-run metrics: rows read/valid/quarantined/duplicate/loaded, duration, schema drift warnings, and a computed quality score with configurable weights. Expose via API/CLI and log a summary line. Done when every ingestion run produces a queryable report with pass/fail thresholds.

tasks.name: Log collection & shipping setup
tasks.details: Configure the collector/shipper for application logs (file tail or agent), including batching, compression, retry with backoff, and offset checkpointing so restarts don't lose or duplicate lines. Add a synthetic log generator for local dev. Done when logs from a sample app reach the landing store with at-least-once delivery.

tasks.name: Log parser registry & format detection
tasks.details: Build the registry only: per-stream format detection, parser selection by interface, and a parse-failure counter with sample payloads. Ships with a no-op parser so the pipeline can run end to end before concrete formats land. Done when an unknown format is detected and routed to a failure bucket without crashing the stream.

tasks.name: Severity & timestamp normalization
tasks.details: Map vendor levels (WARN/WARNING/ERR/CRITICAL etc.) onto a canonical severity scale, parse multiple timestamp formats and timezones to UTC, and flag skewed/future timestamps. Done when a mixed-format fixture normalizes to a single scale with zero unparsed timestamps.

tasks.name: Error fingerprinting & grouping
tasks.details: Collapse noisy messages into stable groups: strip volatile tokens (IDs, UUIDs, timestamps, numbers, paths) then hash the template. Track first-seen, last-seen, and occurrence count per fingerprint. Done when a spike of one error type groups into a single fingerprint with a representative sample.

tasks.name: Time-bucket rollup engine
tasks.details: Implement bucketing only: assign events to 1m/1h/1d buckets, maintain incremental counters by severity and service, and recompute affected buckets for late-arriving events. No percentile math in this task. Done when bucket counts reconcile exactly against a brute-force count over the same window.

tasks.name: Retention policy, backfill & replay tooling
tasks.details: Define hot/cold retention windows, implement partition drop/archival, and provide a replay command that reprocesses a date range from the landing store into aggregations idempotently. Done when replaying a 7-day range leaves aggregates unchanged (idempotent).

tasks.name: Dimensional model: facts, dimensions & DDL
tasks.details: Design the star schema for customer and log-derived facts with conformed dimensions (date, service, customer, severity). Write migrations/DDL with indexes and partition keys on time. Done when migrations apply cleanly from scratch and on top of an existing DB.

tasks.name: Metric catalogue & definitions
tasks.details: Write one canonical definition per metric used by the dashboard (active customers, new customers, churn, error rate, p95 latency, top error count, etc.): formula, grain, filters, owner, and known caveats. Wire each definition to a named query constant so UI and API cannot drift. Done when every planned widget maps to a catalogue entry.

tasks.name: Rollup / materialization jobs
tasks.details: Implement scheduled materialization of daily/hourly aggregates (materialized views or summary tables) with incremental refresh and a full-rebuild fallback. Add freshness metadata recorded per table. Done when dashboard queries hit rollups only and freshness is visible.

tasks.name: Time-series query endpoints
tasks.details: Implement GET endpoints returning bucketed series with configurable interval, time range, and granularity selection (auto-rollup). Include response envelope with units, bucket size, and applied timezone. Done when p95 latency under load target and results match direct SQL for sample windows.

tasks.name: Filtering, pagination & drill-down endpoints
tasks.details: Add parameterized filters (date range, service, severity, customer segment, search) with allow-listed fields, cursor-based pagination, and drill-down endpoints returning the underlying rows for a clicked aggregate. Done when filter combinations are validated and invalid fields return clear 400s.

tasks.name: API auth, rate limiting & query caching
tasks.details: Add authentication/authorization for dashboard consumers, per-client rate limits, request timeouts, and a short-TTL cache keyed on normalized query parameters. Done when unauthenticated calls are rejected, limits return 429 with headers, and cache hits are observed for repeated queries.

tasks.name: Chart wrapper base & theme tokens
tasks.details: Build the shared foundation only: base wrapper component, common props contract (series, axes, tooltip, legend), color token mapping to the theme, and the data-to-series mapper with unit tests. Concrete chart types come in a follow-up task. Done when a sample series renders in both themes through the base wrapper.

tasks.name: KPI tile & sortable data table components
tasks.details: Build KPI tiles (value, delta vs previous period, trend indicator, units) and a sortable/paginated data table with column config and number/date formatting. Done when both are documented in the component catalogue with usage examples.

tasks.name: Global filter bar & URL state sync
tasks.details: Implement date-range picker, segment/service/severity selects, and search, with state serialized to the URL so views are shareable and back/forward works. Debounce inputs and cancel in-flight requests. Done when copying a URL reproduces the exact filtered view.

tasks.name: Dashboard layout, navigation shell & routing
tasks.details: Create the app shell: nav sidebar, page routes (overview, customers, logs, drill-down), responsive grid system for widget placement, and a dark/light theme token set. Done when all planned pages render skeleton widgets in the grid.

tasks.name: Widget data-fetching layer
tasks.details: Implement the typed query client only: endpoint wrappers, request caching, deduplication, retry policy, cancellation, and typed response models. No presentation work here. Done when widgets can request data through one hook and duplicate requests collapse into a single call.

tasks.name: Responsive behavior & accessibility pass
tasks.details: Make the widget grid collapse gracefully to tablet and mobile, give every chart an accessible text alternative plus a data-table fallback, ensure keyboard navigation for filters and drill-down, visible focus states, and WCAG AA contrast in both themes. Done when automated axe checks pass and keyboard-only walkthrough of each page succeeds.

tasks.name: Pipeline unit tests (CSV + log parsers)
tasks.details: Write unit tests over fixture files covering malformed CSV rows, encoding edge cases, each log format, multi-line stack traces, severity mapping, and fingerprint stability. Target meaningful coverage of transform functions with golden-file assertions. Done when suite runs in CI in under 2 minutes.

tasks.name: API contract & integration tests
tasks.details: Add contract tests validating response schemas for each endpoint against the published spec, plus integration tests against a seeded ephemeral database verifying aggregation correctness and filter behavior. Done when breaking an endpoint's response shape fails CI.

tasks.name: UI component & state tests
tasks.details: Add component tests for chart wrappers, KPI tiles, table sorting/pagination, and widget state rendering (loading, empty, error, stale) with mocked API responses. Done when every widget has at least one state test.

tasks.name: Data quality regression checks & alerting
tasks.details: Add scheduled assertions on production-like data: row counts within expected bands, null-rate ceilings, freshness SLA, duplicate-rate limits, and parse-failure thresholds, each emitting an alert. Done when a deliberately corrupted fixture triggers the expected alerts.

tasks.name: CI/CD pipeline & staging environment provisioning
tasks.details: Extend the CI workflow to build artifacts/images, run migrations, execute the full test suite, and deploy to staging on merge with a manual promotion gate to production. Include environment variables/secret injection and rollback procedure. Done when a merge reaches staging automatically and can be rolled back in one step.

tasks.name: Runbook & user documentation
tasks.details: Write the operational runbook (how to rerun ingestion, replay logs, rebuild rollups, respond to alerts, rotate secrets) and end-user docs (what each dashboard view means, metric definitions, filter tips). Done when an on-call engineer can resolve the three most likely incidents using the runbook alone.
